# LinearVelocity

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("LinearVelocity")`

Keeps the part that `Attachment0` is on moving at a set velocity, using up to `MaxForce`. Use it for a crate on a conveyor, a gliding platform or a projectile that does not slow down. In `Line` and `Plane` modes it controls only the speed along a line or within a plane and leaves the rest of the motion free, so a puck held at a speed along a rail still falls.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
